purpose: Mandatory fresh effective-src_64 feedback-loop check immediately before the Magic ROS production-composition modification.

source_facts.fact: MAGIC_SUMMON_BUY is MID70 and MAGIC_SUMMON_SWITCH_HERO is MID71.
magicSummonHero sends the MID70 request and consumes result/stick_items as returned awards.
MID71 submits only the player-selected partner_id; MID70 submits partner_id plus summon_time 1 or 10.
The activity mirror independently uses deterministic MID71 selected-target switching and MID70 buy requests with summon_time 1/10.

implementation_decision: Inject the existing request-scoped RandomOutcomeService through NamespacedRandbelowAdapter(namespace=summon.magic) into MagicSummonPrivatePlanner production composition only.
